name: Runner Extras - TestPage modal page handler
brief: Proves a page opened with RunModal from AL is routed to the test's [ModalPageHandler], and that the handler's OK/Cancel reaches the calling AL.
description: AL that opens a modal page under test is answered by the test codeunit's ModalPageHandler. BC routes this through NavTestExecution.FindPageType, which reads form.MasterPage.PageProperties.PageType — and MasterPage was null for any form the runner had not itself built, so every modal page raised a NullReferenceException instead of reaching its handler. Thirty Pageworks tests declare HandlerFunctions. The negatives matter: a handler that cancels must make the calling AL see Cancel rather than OK, and a modal page with no declared handler must raise BC's own missing-handler error rather than silently returning a default result.
